_comment: Guard hook configuration. protected = deny write; allowlist = always allow (overrides protected); self_guard = deny write to hook/config/settings themselves (anti-tamper). Patterns are bash regex (unanchored, use ^ $ for full match). Protected paths are scoped to known benchmark data roots (ascendc-kernelgen-data*) to avoid false positives on unrelated directories that happen to contain 'benchmark' in their name.
